description: This file defines the CordzHandle class and its subclass CordzSnapshot, which manage object lifetime and deletion queues for profiling objects in the Abseil library. It includes synchronization primitives and mechanisms for safe deletion and inspection of objects related to CordzInfo and CordzSampleToken.

classes.name: CordzHandle
classes.description: Manages object lifetime, deletion queue, and snapshot status for profiling objects, with thread-safe mechanisms for deletion and inspection.

classes.name: CordzSnapshot
classes.description: A subclass of CordzHandle representing a snapshot, indicating a safe point-in-time view of objects.

methods.name: is_snapshot
methods.description: Returns whether this handle is a snapshot.

methods.name: SafeToDelete
methods.description: Checks if the handle is safe to delete, i.e., not referenced by active snapshots or in the delete queue.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Static method to delete or enqueue a handle for deletion when safe.

methods.name: DiagnosticsGetDeleteQueue
methods.description: Returns current delete queue entries in LIFO order.

methods.name: DiagnosticsHandleIsSafeToInspect
methods.description: Checks if a handle is safe to inspect, considering if it is guarded by this handle.

methods.name: DiagnosticsGetSafeToInspectDeletedHandles
methods.description: Returns handles in delete queue protected by this handle.

methods.name: ODRCheck
methods.description: Performs a check for ODR violations in the global queue.
